Name: Illume
Description:
ILLUME by Luxury Tribe is an immersive knowledge and experience forum for the luxury travel trade — a place where a destination is not presented, but properly understood.

The way the luxury trade learns a destination has not kept pace with the way the luxury traveller experiences one. Brochures, fam trips, and showcase formats were built for a different era of selling. Today's discerning traveller is shaped by nuance, context, and feel — and the trade serving them needs the same depth to sell with conviction. ILLUME exists to close that gap.

Each edition takes the trade inside a single destination, in a format designed for absorption rather than exposure. Curated immersions, intimate exchanges with the people who shape the destination on the ground, and the kind of unhurried time that lets understanding actually settle. Buyers leave with the instinct to recommend a destination the way only someone who has truly known it can.

ILLUME is intentionally small. It is invitation-led. It moves at the pace of attention, not agenda. The forum is built for those who recognise that in luxury, depth of knowledge is the product — and that the trade's ability to translate a destination is what separates a sale from a relationship.

It is also a meeting of peers. The buyers in the room are among the most considered in the Indian market; the destinations and brands hosted are chosen with the same care. What emerges is a sharper reading of the luxury market itself, built in the company of people who shape it.

That sharper reading also takes published form. Each year, ILLUME releases a trend report drawn from the forum's conversations, observations, and signals — Next Frontier: India's Luxury Travel Trends 2025, followed by the 2026 study on the personas redefining India's luxury traveller. Together they form an evolving record of how the market is shifting, written from inside the room.

2.	Forward-Looking vs. Backward-Looking: Unlike traditional M&A databases that show historical transactions, The M&A Compass provides a "lens into expected M&A"—predicting future M&A intentions and emerging trends
3.	Theme-Based Analysis: Precise search by industry theme rather than inaccurate standard industry classifications and keywords used by legacy databases

Business closed in September 2024. We are actively looking for partners to develop an updated version of our AI-based predictive analytics for the M&A markets.
